events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day public Mary Kay beauty activation built around the brand's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with beauty touch-ups, interactive photo moments and product giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay's organizer-hosted Eventbrite listing advertises 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products; current event listings also advertise beauty touch-ups and full-size product giveaways.
events.caveats: The Mary Kay U.S.-organized Eventbrite page is live and free, while independent current listings describe the activation as open to the public. The verified sources do not establish that advance registration is mandatory, so the RSVP is treated as optional rather than required. Giveaway inventory is finite.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. A free Eventbrite registration path is available, but current public-event listings also describe the activation as open to the public.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded eos × NYLON truck celebrating Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments on the final day of NYFW.
events.what_is_free: Product samples and sweet treats are advertised while supplies last; no purchase requirement is stated.
events.caveats: Two current public-event sources agree on September 15, 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway and describe the truck as open to the public. Samples and treats are while supplies last. No RSVP or approval requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. Walk in; promotional inventory is limited.

events.event_name: Walk the Runway at Century 21 NYC
events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week runway experience on Century 21's main floor where visitors can walk the runway and be filmed for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: Century 21 says every runway walker receives a free tote, up to five iron-on patches pressed on at the station, and a $21-off-$100 in-store card; totes and patches are while supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21 explicitly says there is no ticket, RSVP or invitation. Walking the runway means being filmed for Century 21's Instagram/TikTok stories. Totes and patch selection are while supplies last; the $21-off-$100 card is an optional retail discount, not a purchase requirement for participation.
events.practical_notes: September 15 and 16 from 12–6 PM each day, on the main floor/Dey Street side. Get in line; no signup is required.

events.address: 2 Herald Square, outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Hempz Serene Waters with Magnesium pop-up outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square with drinks, mini body lotions, scratch-off prizes and a limited first-in-line Calm Kit giveaway.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free magnesium iced teas, lavender cold-foam matchas and Serene Waters mini body lotions while supplies last; the first 50 in line are advertised to receive a Calm Kit. Scratch-offs may award additional prizes.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM at Herald Square and describe the main pop-up as open to the public. Free items are while supplies last. A separate 4–6:30 PM influencer meet-and-greet has its own Eventbrite listing and should not be mistaken for a requirement to enter the general pop-up. Some gifts are tied to in-store purchase.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty at Herald Square. Walk in for the general pop-up; arrive early for limited giveaways.

events.what_it_is: A 21+ public launch pop-up for BuzzBallz's limited-edition BuzzBagz handbag collection during NYFW.
events.what_is_free: There is no admission charge stated. The BuzzBagz themselves are retail products priced at $100 each; the official launch announcement says visitors do not need to buy a bag to sample the Dirty Shirley flavor that inspired the collection.
events.caveats: 21+ only. BuzzBagz cost $100 and are available while supplies last. The brand announcement confirms a 3 PM start but does not publish a firm closing time; do not rely on a secondary-source 5 PM end as guaranteed. Alcohol sampling, if offered, is age-restricted.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 beginning at 3 PM at 45 Lispenard Street. Walk-in public retail launch; arrive early because the bags are limited.
